base: prior December 31 balances / prior four-quarter FY revenue, available by origin September 1; annual seasonal alignment; no use of later actuals
predictions: multiply identical frozen prior FY intensities by each of the three unaltered FY revenue predictions in comparison.json; additional benchmark repeats prior FY balances
counterfactual: actual FY revenue times identical frozen intensities; hindsight attribution only; never selected as forecast
metrics: mean(sum absolute three component errors / actual FY revenue)*100
signed AR+inventory-AP error; balance subset not cashflow
missing_policy: retain all 18 positions; nonpositive/ambiguous or duplicate base blocks input, missing actual only blocks evaluation, six future positions retained
decision: diagnostic only; report both companies and each origin; no adoption regardless of aggregate improvement; do not retune balance ratios or select revenue models after evaluation
boundary: two exposed companies; 12 mature forecast positions reuse six company/FY actuals; incomplete working capital not FCFF or valuation accuracy; later-acquired TDX FN314 date proxy not strict PIT
